errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is not marked with numerical values or intervals. The percentage values are displayed as data labels at the end of each bar.
The chart is sorted in ascending order of percentage value from top to bottom, not from bottom to top. The lowest value (10.9%) is at the top and the highest value (82.6%) is at the bottom.
